t.zh: 传送带移动了工件，直接比较会把移动也标成变化。夹具已经测出取样偏移，不需要你估计位移。给比较器补上位置对应，再用真正的缺口检验它。 <wiki-ref to="spatial-correspondence"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The conveyor moved the item, so direct comparison reports motion as change. A fixture already measured the sampling offset; you do not estimate it. Add correspondence before comparison and test a real defect. <wiki-ref to="spatial-correspondence"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: 已知位移能修复这部分位置对应，但没有解决未知配准。移动位置与改变亮度是不同操作。 <wiki-ref to="spatial-correspondence"></wiki-ref>
after.en: A known offset repairs correspondence, not unknown registration. Moving sample positions differs from changing intensity. <wiki-ref to="spatial-correspondence"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 夹具给出了取样偏移 dx、dy。先按它读取观测图，再与参照比较；图外取 0。
brief.en: The fixture supplies sampling offsets dx and dy. Read the observation at those offsets before comparing with the reference; outside reads are zero.

naiveWhy.zh: 错位让原本相同的结构落在不同位置。调整亮度不能修复位置对应。
naiveWhy.en: Misalignment compares different structures; changing intensity cannot repair correspondence.

hint.zh: 正 dx 表示输出 (x,y) 读取观测的 (x+dx,y+dy)，不表示把亮度加上 dx。
hint.en: Positive dx means output (x,y) reads observation (x+dx,y+dy); it does not add dx to brightness.

t.zh: 相机只观测了图内的格子，位移取样会碰到缺少的邻居。本任务假设图外读数为 0；先查看独立示例，区分已有读数与补入的值。
t.en: The camera observed only cells inside the image. Offset sampling can reach missing neighbours. This task assumes zero outside; compare observed and supplied values in the independent example.

desc.zh: 按给定 dx、dy 读取观测，再与参照逐位置比较；图外取 0。
desc.en: Read an observation at dx,dy offsets and compare with the reference, using zero outside.
